thread:
alex: heads-up — after the kernel-selector change yesterday i'm seeing A100 p99 regressions for batched kv-heavy requests. small single-request latency looks fine, but when packing triggers p99 jumps.
vikram: yep noticed that on the nightly run. roughly +18% p99 for seq=2048 workloads. throughputs steady but tail is worse.
eva: can you paste the perf harness command you used? i want to reproduce locally on the a100 node
alex: ./perf-runner --card A100 --seq 2048 --model redwood-vicuna --runs 800 --enable-kv
alex: quick profiling dump attached to perf-bucket: gs://redwood-perf/a100/kernel-sel-4316543.trace
perf-bot: profiling upload complete — report: https://perf.redwood/reports/4316543210-kernel-sel-a100 (contains flamegraphs + kernel timelines)
vikram: flamegraph shows extra memcpy spikes when packing threshold crosses ~6 requests. seems like we fall back to memcpy-heavy kernel on certain kernel-selector paths.
tess: could be kernel fallthrough in selector heuristics — fallback to generic kernel for mixed seq shapes. maybe the selector now prefers a kernel with worse kv handling.
eva: initial mitigation idea: reduce max_tokens_per_batch for A100 so we avoid mixed-shape packing that triggers fallthrough. lower bound to keep throughput ok but drop worst-case tail.
alex: suggested quick config patch to test:
```
max_tokens_per_batch:
  A100: 8192  # was 16384
  H100: 16384
  A10: 4096
  L4: 2048
  T4: 1024
queue_policy:
  favor_small_requests: true
  kv_preserve_order: true
token_budget_target: "0.75"
```
vikram: run that on staging + rerun perf-runner 3x. also run occupancy profile to ensure we're not underutilizing cards.
eva: ran patch on staging a100 pool — quick numbers: p99 down ~12% vs post-change baseline, throughput -4% but still within SLO. attaching summary: p50 35ms, p90 78ms, p99 210ms (was 240ms).
alex: good. next step: sweep A10/L4/T4 values because packing behavior differs by kernel geometry. we shouldn't apply same ratio across families.
tess: recommended sweep ranges:
- A10: 3072, 4096, 6144
- L4: 1024, 2048, 3072
- T4: 512, 1024, 1536
- H100: keep at 16384 for now but validate at high kv-frag scenarios
perf-bot: queued sweeps: sweep-id=sw-4316543. results will land in gs://redwood-perf/sweeps/sw-4316543/
vikram: also important — kernel-selector needs a tie-breaker when KV-fragmentation > 0.6: prefer kernels with in-place kv handling. filing a tiny selector tweak PR.
eva: PR drafted, tests passing locally. adding a fallback probemap to prefer kv-optimized kernel when packing mix detected.
alex: action items:
- vikram: run the specified sweep across A10/L4/T4 and upload results (due EOD)
- tess: merge the selector-tiebreaker PR behind feature flag and roll to canary
- eva: validate H100 under synthetic kv-frag load
- alex: if sweeps confirm, we'll update max_tokens_per_batch matrix and promote to prod config
vikram: noted. starting sweep now.
eva: one more note — make sure the rollout gating checks p99 and kv-frag rate. if kv-frag > 0.4 and p99 regresses, auto rollback.
alex: +1. thanks all, will watch perf-bot updates. :thumbsup:
